notes.title: HotBunz_1_2_1_1 Steam Patch
notes.content:
[b]Hey Buttopians[/b]

It's been a while, hasn't it? We're well into the new year and working hard to bring improvements to the game. At the moment we've brought in the following changes:

[list]
[*][h3]Localizations[/h3]
We've added support for Simplified Chinese and Japanese languages. 
[i]* Please be aware that text-based VFX in the multiplayer modes have not been translated. Audio as well.[/i][/list]
[list]
[*][h3]Tutorial Update[/h3]
The tutorial has been reworked to players a more cohesive experience.[/list]
[list]
[*][h3]Game Progression[/h3]
Levels are initially locked and are now only unlockable through chronological gameplay (I know, duh!)[/list]
[list]
[*][h3]Additional Fixes[/h3]
- Added physics to round butt in the menu's 
- Updated the controls asset in the solo tutorial to reflect the solo controls 
- Fixed an overlapping issue on a Heart Butt skin 
- Fixed an issue causing the text in the level select to overlap on specific languages 
- Fixed an issue causing text in the pause menu to appear at different sizes in specific languages 
- Fixed an issue resulting in the title in the shop appearing stretched in Chinese (Simple) 
- Fixed an issue causing the coin counter to display an incorrect value
- Fixed an issue causing the death box in the tutorial not to spawn 
- Fixed an issue causing the inverted butt to have transparent skins 
[/list]

And that's about it. We hope you guys have a blast,

[i]Yours sincerely
An Overzealous Employee[/i]

notes.title: HotBunz UPDATE 0.4.1.0
notes.content:
We recently launched our new VS Mode with our last build. We patched it up a bit and threw these extra changes in:

[h2]Solo[/h2]
- Updated the city environment background 

[h2]Vs[/h2]
- VS mode is now live! Battle it out with your closest friends or worst enemies in up to 4 Player gastric combat and toot your way to victory. 
- VS mode is now accessible from the main menu 
- Added King of the Hill mode  
- Added functionality for multiple players to emote(twerk) at once 

[h2]General [/h2]
- Fixed an issue causing players to appear invisible in the main menu 
- Added new instructional transition screens between levels

[i]Farts Silenced
Some Happy Guy at SpaceSalad[/i]

notes.title: HotBunz Stream
notes.content:
[h3][b]Spacesalad Studios' developers come together to stream a new Hotbunz VS Mode.[/b][/h3]

Watch us battle it out over who can hold the Plunger Key the longest. Steal it from each other and try to stay afloat while grasping onto glory! There can only be one Victor and it sure isn't Studdley.

notes.title: VS Mode Update
notes.content:
Hey, Buttopians!

We’ve heard your cries and we know it gets pretty lonely in Buttopia, but fear not. HotBunz has gone multiplayer!

That’s right, you’re now able to fart it off against other people with our spanking new VS Mode! While not necessarily a big secret, the mode’s been available for all to see on our Home Screen but has been inaccessible. The guys here at SpaceSalad have been slaving away, joyfully so, ensuring they deliver all the multiplayer thrills.

This comes with a barrage of other updates, such as *checks notes*:

A King of The Hill Update. Get The Key, and survive as long as you can while others try to steal it from you.
A new level.
An infamous store known as The Booty Hole (working title),
And bangin’ new music

It’s a glorious time in Buttopia, and what better way than to share that experience with a loved one?

Farts Silenced
Some Lovely Guy at SpaceSalad
